tools.name: compare_competitor
tools.description: Returns CaptiveWiFi's published feature-by-feature comparison against a named competitor (Purple WiFi, Stampede, Wireless Social, Fydelia, or Beambox). Read-only.

tools.name: get_developer_docs_summary
tools.description: Returns pointers to CaptiveWiFi's real developer/integration resources, so an agent looking to integrate finds the actual docs instead of guessing URLs.

tools.name: search_features
tools.description: Searches CaptiveWiFi's feature and industry/vertical pages for a query (e.g. "restaurants", "gamification", "API") and returns the best-matching pages with title, url and description. Read-only.
